title: Campbell's® debuts new sauces lineup to make dinnertime simple - The Campbell's Company
summary: In partnership with pro dancer Witney Carson, Campbell's rolls out Two-Step Tuesdays, proving delicious weeknight dinners are two steps away.
body_markdown:
*In partnership with pro dancer, Witney Carson, the brand rolls out Two-Step Tuesdays by Campbell’s — proving delicious weeknight dinners are just two steps away*


Two-Step Tuesdays by Campbell’s Kits


CAMDEN, N.J., Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — Delicious dinners that feel special to serve are just two steps away with the launch of four new *Campbell’s* Sauces. Simply cook a favorite protein and add your sauce for a satisfying dinner in 20 minutes or less. Designed for the 60% of Americans who prefer to spend less than 30 minutes cooking dinner,¹ *Campbell’s* Sauces make it surprisingly simple to bring something special to the table for up to a family of four.


To celebrate the Sauces’ two step cooking process, *Campbell’s* and pro dancer, Witney Carson, are teaming up to encourage fans to two-step their way into a delicious dinner by offering the first-ever Two-Step Tuesdays by *Campbell’s* Kit to simplify their weeknight routine.


### **Introducing New Campbell’s Sauces**


Available in four full-bodied flavors, *Campbell’s* Sauces offer comforting favorites for every taste:


- Creamy Lemon Garlic Sauce: Brings bright citrus and buttery garlic flavor to a dinner favorite.
- Smothered Chicken Sauce: Offers savory, Creole-inspired flavor that turns everyday chicken into a comforting, homestyle meal.
- Butter Chicken Sauce: Delivers creamy tomato flavor layered with warm Indian spices and gentle heat.
- Thai Curry Sauce: Blends savory yellow curry and coconut for a rich, mildly spiced twist on dinner.


“For generations, *Campbell’s* has been a trusted partner in the kitchen, helping families create meals they love,” said Rebecca Duke, Senior Director of Brand Marketing at The Campbell’s Company. “With *Campbell’s* Sauces, it’s even simpler to create a delicious dinner that feels special. Our Two-Step Tuesdays by *Campbell’s* Kits and partnership with Witney Carson bring that promise to life in a fun and unexpected way for fans across America.”


### **Introducing Two-Step Tuesdays By Campbell’s**


Campbell’s is teaming up with pro dancer, Witney Carson, to drop the limited-edition Two-Step Tuesdays by Campbell’s Kits


As Witney Carson navigates long days and life off stage, *Campbell’s* Sauces are helping her bring a simple, versatile dinner to the table, even on her busiest nights.


“After long, busy days, the last thing I want is to overthink dinner,” said Witney Carson. “I love anything that makes getting a delicious meal on the table feel simple, which is why *Campbell’s* Two-Step Tuesdays are so perfect for our family. With *Campbell’s* new Sauces, dinner comes together in just two simple steps – no complicated cooking!”


Fans can get in on the two-step fun with limited-edition Two-Step Tuesdays by *Campbell’s* Kits, featuring all four *Campbell’s* Sauces flavors, recipe inspiration cards and kitchen accessories including a cooking pan, a disco ball kitchen timer, meal judging paddles and a gift card to purchase fans’ protein of choice. Fans can enter for a chance to win a kit via[www.campbells.com/twosteptuesdays](https://www.campbells.com/twosteptuesdays/) beginning Tuesday, Sept. 15, while supplies last. No purchase necessary. Open to U.S. + DC 18+ (19+ for AL and NE, 21+ for MS. Starts September 15, 2026 and ends September 22, 2026.


*Campbell’s* Sauces are available now for an SRP of $2.79 at retailers nationwide. For more information and recipe inspiration, visit[Campbells.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774178-1&h=175979469&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.campbells.com%2Fsauces%2F&a=Campbells.com) and @Campbells on[TikTok](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774178-1&h=2915957874&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4730427-1%26h%3D1474571204%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.tiktok.com%252F%2540campbells%253Flang%253Den%26a%3DTikTok&a=TikTok) and[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774178-1&h=3792662261&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4730427-1%26h%3D2175629792%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.instagram.com%252Fcampbells%252F%253Fhl%253Den%26a%3DInstagram&a=Instagram) .
